description: Look up detailed information (composition, ingredients, price, format, servings) for one or more specific products by UUID, slug, or name. Use for "tell me about <product>" or to hydrate products you only have ids for (e.g. from the user's stack). Accepts names when you don't have an id yet. For TrustScore rationale, certifications, or testing, call suppco_get_product_trust_score instead.

products.description: One or more product identifiers (max 5): an array of strings, or one string separated by ' | '. Each can be a UUID, slug, or product name. Prefer the ids you already have from a previous product result.

name: suppco_get_product_info
title: Get product info
